counting_policy: one event candidate per canonical source segment and date; translations do not add events

evidence.en: As is, I culled well over 300 cases from the Operação Prato documents and organized them in chronological order (by year, month, date, and time of day), as you will see below. For example, the report on a sighting that occurred at 1:30 a.m. on November 5, 1977, would start with "771105/01:30" and be followed by the location of the incident, the name of the witness, if given, and details of the sighting.

evidence.en: This is not the first time the Brazilian government has been open about UFOs. The most widely publicized event occurred on the night of May 19, 1986, when twenty-one UFOs were tracked on radar crisscrossing the skies over much of the country. Six jet fighters armed with missiles were scrambled from bases near Rio de Janeiro and Brasília, and for several hours the jets chased or were chased by what were described as balls of light.
